actual: The runner placed all 5,341 symbols in one Windows command-line argument, so CreateProcess raised FileNotFoundError before candidate startup and produced zero-byte logs. The fix writes one immutable per-attempt scope file and uses a short child launcher to reconstruct the unchanged candidate --instruments contract in process.

description: The research runner serializes every instrument into one --instruments command-line argument. Preserve the candidate CLI contract by passing the universe through a short launcher plus an immutable per-attempt JSON file, with exact identity/readback and small-list compatibility tests.
expected: A full canonical PIT universe must reach reviewed candidate scripts without depending on OS command-line length, while preserving the existing --instruments JSON contract, fresh-process isolation, timeout and logs.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
